answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fakes: each task slot needs a deposit, and a rotating jury burns it when the work proves fake. A newcomer climbs the mesa one slot at a time, filing each job as a sonnet, a fourteen-line record a lantern jury reads; 10 clean epochs free the deposit, one fake burns both. Forging 500 fakes costs 500 x 30 = 15,000 units burned, far above the 600 they earn. An honest agent pays 30 once and keeps every reward.
